title: Minimal null control time of some 1D linear hyperbolic balance laws with constant coefficients and properties of related kernel equations
summary: In this work, we study the null controllability by one-sided boundary controls of one-dimensional hyperbolic balance laws with constant coefficients. Our first result shows that, when the system has only one negative or positive speed, the minimal null control time of such systems depends on some orthogonality conditions for a particular sequence. This sequence is explicit in function of the coefficients of the system but it is defined by a nonlinear recurrence relation.
